name: Saejima Raime
source:
A strong-willed classmate. He was absent from school for nearly half a year after a certain incident. Has a bad attitude and is feared by others, but also has leadership skills and excels when he’s appointed as leader. Haughty and rebellious, he’s actually weak when it comes to girls and younger students, perhaps because he has four younger sisters. He’s also a surprisingly good cook.

‘You’re a pain in the ass. I already told you I ain’t doing that.’
‘Hey! Don’t cling to me so much! Don’t you see this is dangerous?!’

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]the official Twitter[/url].]
